note: The body figure for the slow path's body step. A picture added beside the list, never in place of it: the list alone reaches every region. Regions carry no emotion and no pleasant/unpleasant value (data/body-signals.*.json fieldNotes.valence). Zone coordinates are fractions of the image's width and height. `region` is the index into body-signals regions, by id, so the same zones serve every language.

credit.lungs: Procedural lungs built for the 「숨과 자세」 3D material, placed in the BodyParts3D frame (no third-party license)
credit.edited: Face left blank (no eyes, nose or mouth). Genitals and nipples removed and the crotch redrawn as a plain curve. No color fills.

layersNote: One style only, the line drawing (owner's decision 2026-11-01: 「선화가 나은 것 같아. 색을 표시하는 건 별로」). The realistic and plain styles and their files were removed; a choice saved earlier with either of them is read as the line drawing.
zonesNote: Coordinates are fractions of the figure width and height. Order matters: a later zone is hit first. Shoulders come after chest and belly so they win where they overlap; the heart is last. Energy and movement stay outside the figure as buttons.
storage: The choice stays on this device (localStorage) and is never written into a record, a summary or an export: the body choice could be read as a statement about the person. `hidden` (no figure at all) is saved the same way.
partsNote: `part` tells apart the zones of one region for a screen reader (neck, left and right shoulder, left and right hand). Left and right are as seen on the screen, i.e. the figure's own right shoulder is the viewer's left.
